verdict.rationale: The docs describe a portable Agent Plugins `plugin.json` schema, skills built on the open agent skills standard, and a migration path for Claude Code plugins. A hands-on probe also installed a catalog skill with the third-party `npx skills add ... -a codex` tool, which shows the skills are plain portable folders rather than a Codex-locked format. However, first-party material targets ChatGPT and Codex, and cross-harness installs rely on external tooling. Missing for 10: documented per-harness install instructions for Claude Code, Cursor and other agents; first-party multi-agent installer; hands-on installs into non-Codex harnesses.
